newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, soybean and wheat basis values were mostly steady on Thursday amid subdued export activity and scant farm sales, dealers said.
More locks along the upper Mississippi River should reopen late this weekend if high water levels continue to drop, the U.S. Coast Guard said.
"If that opens up, there is barge freight waiting to come north," one dealer said.
He said he expected some movement in soybeans but more in corn.
